description: Documentation contract for authored application, runtime, build, API, test, and content source code. Workflow orchestration, generated, vendored, minified, and machine-owned outputs are excluded because their source of truth or documentation conventions live elsewhere.

commentRules.fileHeader: Every authored application/tooling code file must explain purpose, responsibilities, connections, execution context, and maintenance constraints near the start of the file.
commentRules.namedFunctions: Every named function, method, constructor, getter, setter, and assigned arrow/function expression must have an explanatory comment describing purpose, inputs, side effects, and return behavior.
commentRules.callbacks: Inline callbacks must have a nearby concise explanatory comment. Trivial callbacks may use a compact one-line block comment; complex callbacks should use a multi-line explanation.
commentRules.generatedCode: Generated or vendored code is documented at its generator/owner instead of being hand-edited.
commentRules.workflowConfiguration: GitHub Actions YAML is orchestration configuration and is documented through workflow/job/step naming plus repository workflow documentation rather than code-function comments.
